method: Every event and every year below is taken from the Plot section of the Wikipedia article on the film, fetched 14 Nov 2026 by the Workshop run (no research child). Where the plot gives a decade or no year, the row says so and the page draws it as a range or leaves it off the axis. Strand labels follow the committed film page (films/oppenheimer.json): colour for Oppenheimer's own story and the 1954 hearing, black and white for the 1959 Senate hearing. Film order is not in this file: no fetched source gives scene timestamps.

strands.name: His life, in colour
strands.what: Oppenheimer's own story, from study in Europe to Los Alamos and after

strands.name: The 1954 hearing, in colour
strands.what: The security clearance hearing Strauss set up

strands.name: The 1959 hearing, in black and white
strands.what: Strauss's Senate confirmation hearing for Secretary of Commerce

events.quote: after studying theoretical physics in Europe

events.what: Teaches at Caltech and Berkeley; colleagues in the Communist Party, he does not join
events.quote: In the 1930s, J. Robert Oppenheimer teaches at the California Institute of Technology and the University of California, Berkeley

events.what: Gains his security clearance and rekindles the affair with Jean Tatlock
events.quote: immediately after gaining his security clearance in 1942

events.what: The Trinity test, then Hiroshima and Nagasaki, then the Oval Office
events.quote: In July 1945, the US Army successfully conducts the Trinity test

events.what: A conversation with Einstein at Princeton, seen by Strauss from a distance
events.quote: starting with Albert Einstein at Princeton University in 1947

events.what: The Soviet bomb; Oppenheimer argues for arms talks over Teller's thermonuclear weapon, and frustrates Strauss
events.quote: In 1949, the Soviet Union successfully tests a plutonium bomb

events.what: Strauss and Borden start a clearance hearing; Robb replays the accusations; the Q clearance is revoked two to one
events.quote: In 1954, irritated at constantly being undermined by Oppenheimer, Strauss conspires

events.what: Strauss's confirmation hearing; Hill exposes the vendetta; the Senate rejects him
events.quote: In 1959, Strauss is nominated as US Secretary of Commerce

events.what: Oppenheimer receives the Enrico Fermi Award
events.quote: While Oppenheimer receives the Enrico Fermi Award in 1963

lookbacks.what: Strauss tells the Senate Oppenheimer turned scientists against him, starting with Einstein
lookbacks.quote: Strauss further alleges that Oppenheimer turned scientists against him, starting with Albert Einstein at Princeton University in 1947

lookbacks.what: A flashback shows Strauss was never mentioned: they talked about the catastrophe they had feared, now inevitable
lookbacks.quote: a flashback reveals he never mentioned Strauss during his 1947 conversation with Einstein

modes.text: Nolan described the colour scenes as subjective and the black-and-white scenes as objective.

first_person.text: He wrote the screenplay in the first person, his first time doing so.

ending.text: The closing flashback moves the weight of the film from Strauss's wounded pride to Oppenheimer's guilt.

sources.what: Plot section: every event, year and quote above
colour as subjective, black and white as objective
